name: RSS Guard Lite
tagline: Simple, yet powerful news feed reader (without web browser)
blurb: RSS Guard Lite is a news feed reader, written in C++ and Qt.
description:
RSS Guard Lite is a news feed reader, written in C++ and Qt.

It supports many feed formats, such as:

• ATOM

• JSON (1.x)

• RSS (0.x, 1.x, 2.x)

It also supports many web-based feed services, including:

• Feedly

• Gmail

• Google Reader API (Bazqux, FreshRSS, Inoreader, Miniflux, Reedah, The Old Reader, etc.)

• Next Cloud News

• Tiny Tiny RSS

• XMPP PubSub

• Gemini Protocol

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
